This 2027 Kia Telluride X-Pro SX-Prestige delivers the versatility and capability you need for every journey, whether you're navigating city streets or exploring beyond them.

- AWD system for confident handling in all conditions
- Panoramic sunroof for enhanced cabin brightness
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with power adjustment
- Heated rear seats and steering wheel for comfort
- Lane Keeping Assist and Lane Following Assist for safer driving
- Blind-Spot Detection and Driver Attention Warning
- Backup camera with exterior parking camera rear view
- Fully automatic headlights with auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Premium 18 X-Pro exclusive alloy wheels
- 14-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Front dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Three-row seating configuration with split-folding rear seat and reclining third row

This vehicle has undergone a comprehensive 112-point inspection and full reconditioning, with all maintenance completed to ensure it operates at peak performance. With just 6,225 miles on the odometer, this Telluride delivers near-new condition backed by remaining factory warranty coverage. The previous owner clearly maintained this vehicle with exceptional care, and now it's ready for its next chapter with you.

The Telluride's three-row layout provides flexible seating for up to eight passengers, making it ideal for families and group travel. Interior amenities include memory seats, heated and ventilated front bucket seats, and heated rear seats, ensuring comfort for all occupants. The automatic temperature control system maintains your preferred climate across multiple zones.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, ABS brakes, and the advanced suspension system work together to keep you secure on the road. The 911 Connect emergency communication system provides additional peace of mind during your travels.

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine pairs with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering strong performance with efficiency. The suspension system includes four-wheel independent setup with auto-leveling capability and speed-sensing steering that adapts to your driving conditions.

This Telluride represents a smart choice for buyers seeking a well-maintained three-row SUV with modern technology, genuine comfort features, and proven reliability. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it fits your lifestyle and driving needs.

The leather-wrapped steering wheel features distinctive active orange stitching that reflects the Tremor's bold character. Multiple onboard power outlets keep your devices charged whether you're at a jobsite or campsite, and rear under-seat storage keeps essentials organized.

Safety and visibility work in concert on this truck. LED fog lamps with cornering functionality illuminate your path, while the full suite of airbags, electronic stability control, and Ford Co-Pilot360 2.0 with BLIS and Cross Traffic Alert provide comprehensive protection. Cloth seat trim adds a durable, maintainable finish that resists wear.

Climate control features include air conditioning, a rear window defroster, and a reinforced electric heater system that responds quickly to keep your cabin at the perfect temperature year-round. The power windows, power door mirrors, and heated door mirrors add convenience to daily operation, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel ensures every driver can achieve a comfortable position behind the wheel.

Safety is integrated throughout this vehicle with dual front airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, overhead airbag, and rear side impact airbag protection. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work together to maintain grip during challenging road conditions, while the brake assist system provides confident stopping power. The 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS deliver reliable deceleration, and the low tire pressure warning system helps you maintain optimal tire condition.

This well-equipped 2023 TrailBlazer LT represents a smart investment for buyers who value efficiency, comfort, and dependable performance. With fresh brakes installed and all these thoughtful features ready to serve you, this vehicle is prepared for the road ahead. We invite you to come experience it firsthand and discover why it's the right choice for your driving needs.

This 2014 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sport in gray delivers authentic off-road capability with practical everyday versatility built into a globally recognized platform.

- Black 3-piece hard top with freedom panel storage

- 4-wheel drive with electronic stability and traction control
- Uconnect voice command with Bluetooth connectivity
- Rear passenger assist handles and split folding rear seat

- BF Goodrich brand tires on 17 high gloss black Willys wheels
- Front fog lights and integrated roll-over protection

The Wrangler Unlimited platform has earned its reputation for delivering genuine capability whether you're navigating city streets or exploring remote terrain. This Sport model is equipped with the proven 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission managing power to all four wheels. The Willys Wheeler package adds meaningful enhancements including rock rails, performance suspension tuning, and distinctive badging that signals serious intent.

Inside, the cabin balances function with comfort. A leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob establish a more refined feel, while Uconnect voice command with Bluetooth keeps you connected safely. The split folding rear seat configures easily for passengers or cargo, and front bucket seats with a center armrest provide support during longer drives. Deep tinted windows reduce glare and interior temperatures on warm days.

The black 3-piece hard top provides genuine weather protection while maintaining the iconic Wrangler silhouette. Freedom panel storage keeps the roof components organized when removed, and the rear window features both a defroster and wiper/washer for year-round clarity. Tinted rear quarter and liftgate windows enhance privacy without compromising visibility.

Safety technologies integrated into this Wrangler include electronic stability control, traction control, anti-spin differential, ABS brakes with brake assist, and integrated roll-over protection. Tire pressure monitoring alerts you to any pressure changes, and dual front impact airbags provide additional security.

Expect 16 mpg in the city and 20 mpg on the highway, which reflects the capability and weight of this four-wheel drive platform. The rock rails protect the body during side impacts, while fog lights improve visibility in challenging conditions.

This Wrangler Unlimited Sport represents a legitimate option for buyers seeking authentic four-wheel drive performance without compromise. Schedule your test drive today to confirm whether this vehicle meets your requirements.

description:
This 2015 Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited delivers capable performance with a 3.6L V6 engine paired to an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, offering 17 city and 24 highway mpg for a balanced driving experience.

- Uconnect 8.4 Touchscreen Display with GPS Navigation
- Quadra-Trac II 4WD System
- Dual-Pane Panoramic Sunroof
- Bi-Xenon HID Headlamps with Auto High Beam Control
- LED Daytime Running Headlamps
- Ventilated Front Seats with Leather Trim
- Heated Front and Rear Seats
- Power Tilt/Telescope Steering Column
- 506 Watt Amplifier with 9 Amplified Speakers and Subwoofer
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 1-Year Service
- Class IV Receiver Hitch with Trailer Tow Group IV
- Rear Load Leveling Suspension
- Exterior Parking Camera
- Rain Sensitive Windshield Wipers
- Automatic Headlamp Leveling System

The exterior presents a striking black finish that commands attention on any road. This model is equipped with the Luxury Group II package, which elevates the driving environment with premium features and refined comfort. The Uconnect 8.4 navigation system keeps you connected with integrated voice command and Bluetooth capability, while SiriusXM provides comprehensive satellite radio coverage with traffic and travel link services.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Limited trim's focus on comfort and convenience. Leather-trimmed seats with perforated inserts provide both style and practicality, complemented by ventilated front seats for warm-weather relief and heated seats for colder months. The power tilt/telescope steering column adjusts to your preferences, while the dual-pane panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and creates an open atmosphere.

The advanced lighting package distinguishes this Grand Cherokee with bi-xenon HID headlamps, auto high beam control, LED daytime running headlamps, and automatic headlamp leveling to adapt to various driving conditions. Safety comes through with features including rear parking sensors, a backup camera, multiple airbags, and electronic stability control working together to protect occupants.

For those who tow or haul, the Trailer Tow Group IV package includes a class IV receiver hitch, rear load leveling suspension, and full-size spare tire on a steel wheel. The Quadra-Trac II 4WD system provides dependable traction across varied terrain, while the rear window wiper helps maintain visibility in challenging weather.

This Grand Cherokee Limited represents a well-equipped midsize SUV ready for both daily driving and weekend adventures. Its proven platform, comprehensive feature set, and practical 4WD system make it a solid choice for buyers seeking capability without compromise.

This 2023 Chevrolet Malibu LT 1LT combines practical engineering with thoughtful design to deliver a sedan that meets the needs of today's driver.

- 1.5L DOHC engine with CVT transmission for efficient performance
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility

Front-wheel drive ensures confident traction in various driving conditions.

Inside, the cabin reflects a focus on comfort and connectivity. Premium cloth seat trim provides durability, while the heated front seats add warmth during colder months. The front bucket seats with center armrest create a welcoming environment, and the split-folding rear seat offers flexibility for cargo and passengers. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage your entertainment without taking your eyes off the road.

Climate control features keep all occupants comfortable. The automatic temperature control system works quietly in the background, and the rear window defroster clears visibility quickly. The cabin ventilation system ensures fresh air circulation throughout your drive.

Technology integration is seamless with the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility means your smartphone connects effortlessly, giving you access to navigation, music, and messaging apps. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.

Safety remains paramount with multiple layers of protection. Electronic Stability Control prevents wheel slip during aggressive maneuvers, while the four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections smoothly. The comprehensive airbag system, combined with ABS brakes and the rear backup camera, provides confidence in various driving scenarios. OnStar and Chevrolet connected services are built in for added peace of mind.

This 2023 Malibu LT represents a practical choice for drivers seeking reliability, efficiency, and modern convenience in a midsize sedan. We invite you to schedule your test drive today.

This 2023 Toyota Tundra Limited combines capable truck performance with refined daily practicality, offering the reliability you expect from Toyota in a vehicle built for both work and lifestyle.

- TRD Off-Road Package with Bilstein shocks and multi-terrain capability
- 20 black alloy wheels with all-terrain capability

The truck's silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance while the 4WD system delivers confidence on any surface. The TRD Off-Road Package elevates capability with specialized suspension tuning, skid plate protection, and the multi-terrain back monitor that provides visibility when navigating challenging terrain. These features work together to ensure you're equipped for both paved roads and rougher conditions.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort with heated and ventilated front seats finished in SofTex material. The heated leather steering wheel remains ready for colder mornings, while the power package delivers convenient 120V power outlets for your tools, electronics, or equipment. Wireless charging and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected while the navigation system guides you to your destination.

Safety technology includes blind spot monitoring, automatic high-beam control, and a rearview camera system enhanced by the panoramic monitor for better visibility during reversals. The emergency communication system provides added peace of mind during your travels. Electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain grip in varying conditions.

The 3.4L V6 engine paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission achieves 17 mpg city and 22 mpg highway, balancing the performance capability you need with reasonable fuel economy. The spray-on bed liner protects your cargo investment while all-weather floor liners keep the cabin clean regardless of the season.

This Tundra Limited arrives ready to serve you immediately, equipped with the protection and convenience features that make truck ownership more practical. We invite you to schedule a visit so you can experience the truck's commanding driving position, responsive handling, and the thoughtful interior design that makes each day behind the wheel more enjoyable.
